prayerExcerpt.en-US: "O blessed Rosary of Mary, sweet chain that ties us back to God, bond of love that joins us to the Angels."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Ó bendito Rosário de Maria, corrente suave que nos reata a Deus, laço de amor que nos une aos Anjos."

meta.face: A southern Italian of about sixty with a fair olive complexion and a LONG face under a HIGH, DOMED forehead — thick, wavy dark hair going grey, RECEDING at the temples and brushed back, standing out in soft waves over the ears; deep-set, earnest dark eyes under heavy brows that rise a little at their inner ends, behind a small oval PINCE-NEZ; a LONG, straight nose; a FULL, BROAD, BUSHY beard, dark and streaked with grey, grown from the cheekbones and reaching to the collar, with a full moustache over a closed mouth; the gaze intent and a little upward. Not the pointed chin beard of cesar_de_bus, nor the round spectacles and narrow pointed beard of maximilian_kolbe.
meta.basis: His photographs (Wikimedia Commons: the portrait of about 1900, the photograph at thirty-five, the photograph with his wife in 1920; the Dicastery's portrait drawn from the first): a long face under a high, domed forehead, wavy hair brushed back and receding, deep-set eyes under heavy brows, a pince-nez on a cord and a full, bushy beard, in a frock coat and wing collar. The Dicastery's biography gives the Supplica and his founding of the Pompeii shrine and its works.
meta.excerpt: The close of his Supplica alla Regina del Santo Rosario di Pompei (1883), «O Rosario benedetto di Maria, catena dolce che ci rannodi a Dio, vincolo d'amore che ci unisci agli Angeli», which John Paul II made his own at the end of Rosarium Virginis Mariae (2002); the first two clauses, our rendering from the Italian (he died in 1926), not the Vatican's English or Portuguese
